prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was chatting with a coworker about sightseeing in Xi'an, just swapping notes on what people usually check out there.
Around that same time, my colleague kept talking about taking the train from Beijing to Shanghai and how that route was always packed.
And later on I heard a friend describing hotel options in Shenzhen—mostly just comparing neighborhoods and commute times.
For that Xi'an stop, Li Na had already arranged tickets for Huaqing Palace, and it was set for 2025-05-12.
I remember she mentioned it was the afternoon slot, and they were going as a big group—ticket_count was 5.
My other friend Xu Jing had already ridden train D321 on 2025-03-26, and she said Second Class was totally fine for that trip.
Oh—and Ethan Thomas told me he’d stayed at Home Inn Futian CBD, checking in 2025-05-24, for 4 nights.
